messages:
Anjali (DevRel): Hey everyone — quick announcement: we just shipped the Contrib Day Plugin Starter v1.0.0 to the community repo! 🎉
Release highlights: plugin scaffold (TS), CI + test templates, an example Redwood API adapter, and an updated CONTRIBUTING.md.
Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-plugins/releases/tag/v1.0.0

release-bot: Automated release notes published for community-plugins v1.0.0 — assets: tar.gz, changelog.md, migration-guide.md

Tom (Frontend): awesome — for teams on v0, is there a simple migration path?

Anjali (DevRel): yep, migration guide added. high level: bump package to v1, rename config key `pluginConfig` -> `plugins.config`, and run the compatibility shim once. quick snippet:```bash
# bump version
npm install @redwood/community-plugins@^1.0.0
# run shim to convert config
node scripts/convert-plugin-config.js ./redwood.toml
```
Should be 5-10 min for most small plugins.

Priya (Docs): Can we get a short example added to the docs site? I can PR a tutorial if you can point me to the canonical example.

Anjali (DevRel): docs site already updated with a short step-by-step under /docs/plugins. Example is `examples/basic-adapter` in the release. Please submit the tutorial PR to `gh-pages` branch — I've added a PR template under .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md to make it easier.

Jordan (SRE): happy to help triage issues during Contrib Day. If maintainers want extra hands, ping me and I can allocate time to review CI flakes. :raised_hands:

Ethan (Legal): quick question — do we require a CLA for external maintainers contributing to plugin templates?

Anjali (DevRel): yes, external contributors should sign the contributor license agreement. License for the repo is Apache-2.0. Link to CLA + policy: https://intranet.redwood/legal/cla-plugin-contribs (internal) and public summary in the repo README.

Tom (Frontend): also — what's the recommended test command for validating a plugin locally?

Anjali (DevRel): run `yarn && yarn test:plugin` (included in the release) or `npx redwoodctl plugin lint` for quick static checks. If you hit anything weird, open an issue with the `migration` label and we'll prioritize.

Anjali (DevRel): TL;DR: v1 released, migration guide + docs live, Contrib Day support available. If you're interested in being a listed maintainer for the plugin starter, reply here and I'll add you to the maintainers roster. :rocket:
